snippet.title: Facebook Developer Circle: Moscow
snippet.description:
This is the official channel of Facebook Developer Circle: Moscow, where we post some of our videos.

To see more, get additional learning materials, participate in the mentoring program and not miss new events, join our group https://www.facebook.com/groups/475428499888062/

You can also find other circles (perhaps closer to you) on site https://developers.facebook.com/developercircles/find
